geometryAudit.note: Hair partings inside the outer envelope are allowed. Hair interior audits use the scalp/temple core excluding ears; red means gap, yellow means excessive overlap. Red seam pixels are uncovered within the fixed declared ROI; do not change the ROI to hide a failure. External boundary pixels remain visible in audit images and require review; enclosed holes fail the structural gate.
